graph.goal:
Implement the spacing ladder and home layout change described in docs/design/theme/CONTRACT.md, section "THE SPACING LADDER IS OURS".

Read first, they are the spec and they are dense:
- docs/design/theme/CONTRACT.md (your spec)
- docs/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md, sections "THE SPACING LADDER", "PRESENCE OVER LABELS", "WHAT WE REFUSED"
- internal/tui3/spacing.go (29 lines, the whole current ladder; read its doctrine comment)
- internal/tui3/home.go (homeGutter at line 172, homeColumns at line 3496)
- internal/tui3/homebridge.go (lines 65-92: homeCardCol, homeSwitchFull, homeCardMin, homeTierAt)

A. Grow internal/tui3/spacing.go to add: spacingScreenGutter = 3 (left and right of everything, header and footer included); spacingConversationLead stays 2 UNCHANGED; spacingSubRowIndent = 5 DERIVED as gutter + lead; spacingScopeStep = 2 per level capped at 4 levels, deeper folds instead of indenting; spacingGlyphCol = 2 (glyph then a blank, single-width only, never an emoji); spacingHeadingAbove = 1 (one blank row above a heading and NONE below); spacingRowGap = 0 (rows in a band are adjacent so the band reads as one object). Derive what can be derived rather than authoring it.

B. Home layout. homeGutter was 4; it becomes the 3-cell screen gutter plus a 1-cell divider column carrying a hairline. docs/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md "WHAT WE REFUSED" bans borders but explicitly permits "at most a hairline rule", so this is a rule glyph in the rules colour, not a border. Panes are 58 . 1 . 85 (left, divider, right) at 150 columns, which is exactly 150 - 3 - 3 = 144 = 58 + 1 + 85, so DERIVE it from the gutter rather than hardcoding 58 and 85; the existing code's stated principle is "Everything width-related is derived, not chosen". Right-flush columns are 8 money, 14 project, 5 clock, fixed so they read as columns; the subject flexes and clips with an ellipsis, and you must reuse the existing ellipsis grammar (see fit(...) used in internal/tui3/palette.go line 380) rather than writing a new one. Breakpoints are 140 (two panes) and 90 (one pane); below 90 the bounded HUD. Do NOT touch the global layoutTier in internal/tui3/view.go line 1125 - home has always owned its own breakpoints and the two must stay separate.

C. Tests. internal/tui3/designlanguage_test.go line 33 TestTheSpacingLadderKeepsItsSharedSteps currently asserts homeGutter == 4 and pins spacingConversationLead == 2 == noteLead == railGripCols; update it to the new ladder, keeping the shared-identity assertions that still hold. There is a breakpoints_test.go asserting today's derivations; update it. Add assertions that 58 + 1 + 85 + 3 + 3 == 150 is derived rather than authored, and that the two breakpoints are the only widths home compares.

CONSTRAINTS. Colour is not in scope: do not edit internal/tui3/styles.go, do not add or change any hex anywhere, and do not touch internal/tui3/adaptive.go. The test TestNothingButStylesAuthorsAColour fails the build if a hex is written outside styles.go. For the hairline's colour reference the existing ramp role through the palette methods rather than naming a value.

DONE MEANS: `go build ./...` succeeds and `go test ./internal/tui3/...` passes. Do not stop with failing tests. Match the codebase's prose style - comments explain WHY in full sentences; this codebase writes unusually literate comments, read the neighbours and meet that bar. Commit your work to the current branch.
